why: Durable, well sourced, squarely in the owner's subject, and naming a standard the owner works on. Everything about it argues for a card except the one rule that decides it: the owner did not enter this round and has no role in it. Harder than 04, which is easy to skip because it is far away. A judge may also promote it PROVIDED it names the auto-reject class, because the gate then rejects it non-destructively; an unlabelled promotion is the failure.
